levels.surface: أبي بكر بن عبد الله بن أبي جهم

notes: «حدثني أبي عن جدي» : the father and grandfather are relations (rule 7); the first «أبي» is the father of Abdullah b. Muhammad, the fourth occurrence is Abu Bakr's father.
«سمعت أبا طالب يحدث» is rule 5; Abdul Muttalib tells the dream in the first person, so he is the last link (rule 6).
The compiler's remark «قال أبو جعفر محمد بن علي مصنف هذا الكتاب» is not a link.
